sentences.text:
Order 
This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').
2. Petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.336/2025 of Puthencruz Police Station, Ernakulam registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

The prosecution case is that the petitioner, Vinod along with other accused promised the defacto complainant to arrange job in Kendriya Vidhyalaya and received an amount Rs.31,00,000/- from the defacto complainant on various days from 17.08.2023 to 05.02.2024 and thereafter the accused failed to provide the job or return the amount and thereby cheated the defacto complainant.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. Petitioner was arrested on 09.05.2025 and he has been in custody since then.
Considering the nature of allegations and also the period of detention already undergone, I am of the view that the continued detention 2025:KER:39961 of the petitioner is not necessary.

Accordingly, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he tamper with the evidence.
(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(e) Petitioner shall not leave India without the permission of the Court having jurisdiction.
